name: Contact Form — validates required fields and displays confirmation upon inquiry submission
description: Verifies that the Direct Inquiry form in the Contact section enforces required fields and transitions to the confirmation state when submitted with valid data.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and scroll down into the '#contact' section
The Contact section is displayed with heading 'START YOUR JOURNEY.' and the 'DIRECT INQUIRY' card
The input fields for '#name', '#email', and '#message' and the 'SEND MESSAGE' button are visible
Attempt to click 'SEND MESSAGE' while leaving all fields empty
HTML5 form validation prevents submission and requests completion of the required fields
Fill '#name' with 'Test Rider', '#email' with 'rider@enfield-test.com', and '#message' with 'Inquiring about test ride availability in Mumbai.'
The form transitions to the success screen displaying 'MESSAGE RECEIVED' and a confirmation message
The contact form resets to empty input fields ready for a new inquiry
